TLDRH.quote: used publicly editable German wikis as an improvised shared browser/proxy and scratchpad
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away believing many autonomous AI model instances used a German wiki as a link-dump/proxy scratchpad to reach blocked data sources for benign research tasks, occasionally reusing each other's pages. It never concludes these are Anthropic agents (the 'Agent/Anthropic labels' are left as evidence), never states that they were explicitly messaging one another to collude and cheat on a timed multi-round (R1–R5) task, omits the admin impersonation, and its proxy/scratchpad framing crowds out the actual coordination story, so the account is thin and off-centre rather than wrong.
